userGuide.title: User Guide
userGuide.step1: Write your task: define Instruction + Constraints + Expected style.
userGuide.step2: Add test cases: for each input, provide ideal output.
userGuide.step3: Run: the system auto-searches, tests, and tunes prompts.
userGuide.step4: Review KPIs: Accuracy / F1 / Pass Rate / Estimated Cost / Progress% update after each run.

layer1.title: Describe your goal
layer1.description: QuizAll transforms a single sentence into a multi-step optimized prompt. Tell us what you want, and we'll handle the rest.
layer1.taskPlaceholder: Summarize customer interviews into 5 product requirements.
layer1.contextPlaceholder: Paste any key passages, bullet points, or constraints you already have.
layer1.contextHelp: This helps QuizAll understand existing materials without forcing you to share everything.

layer2.description: Fine-tune the structural instructions and constraints that guide the agents behind the scenes.
layer2.instructionsPlaceholder: Architect → Planner → Editor. Mention checks like 'clarity' and 'determinism'.
layer2.instructionsHelp: Describe how agents should approach the prompt (tone, flow, guardrails).
layer2.examplesPlaceholder: POS || I love this! → Summary: Enthusiastic praise.
layer2.examplesHelp: Share an input/output pair so agents understand the desired output style.
layer2.constraintsHelp: List any format rules, length, safety limits, or tone you care about.

layer3.description: Only open this when you want dataset-style control over samples, schema, and optimization knobs.
layer3.datasetPlaceholder: POS || This highlights the main benefit. NEG || This goes off-topic.
layer3.datasetHelp: List a few positive/negative examples to bias scoring.
layer3.schemaHelp: Define a structure we should follow in the final prompt.
layer3.knobsHelp: Control candidate count, evaluation tests, or sampling behavior.

whyQuizAll.title: ✨ Why QuizAll Beats Plain AI Models
whyQuizAll.subtitle: We run a structured pipeline—spec building, question refinement, multi-agent orchestration, scoring, and outcome-runner selection—so you never just send a single prompt to an LLM.
whyQuizAll.callout: 🚀 Every enhancement goes through Spec → Questions → Agents → Outcome pipeline, so the result you copy is a top candidate after multi-metric scoring.
whyQuizAll.specBuilderDesc: Converts your raw idea into a structured spec so every requirement is explicit before we touch an LLM.
whyQuizAll.questionEngineDesc: We ask targeted follow-ups (Q1-Q3 flow) to disambiguate and reveal context you might have forgotten.
whyQuizAll.llmAgentsDesc: Specialized agents (Architect, Editor, Judge, etc.) craft multiple candidate prompts instead of relying on a single response.
whyQuizAll.metricsDesc: Each candidate is scored on clarity, coherence, style match, safety, cost, and risk to quantify quality.
whyQuizAll.outcomeDesc: The outcome-first runner applies your success criteria, compares best-of-N candidates, and returns the most robust result.
whyQuizAll.specStructuredDesc: JSON-ready blueprint guides every subsequent stage.
whyQuizAll.specOrchestrationDesc: Different agents collaborate on architecture, editing, and judging.
whyQuizAll.specMetricsDesc: Coherence, style, pass rate, cost efficiency, and risk scores influence gain.
whyQuizAll.specSelectionDesc: We compare candidates instead of returning the first hit.
whyQuizAll.specOutcomeDesc: Picks the winner based on tests/criteria you define.

specs.title: Specs Manager
specs.subtitle: Browse, inspect, and compile your QuizAll specs into deterministic prompts.
specs.section1Desc: These specs are stored in the backend database. Select one to see details and compile it.
specs.section2Desc: Inspect the raw spec JSON and compile it into prompt blocks for your LLM pipeline.
specs.section3Desc: Paste or type a JSON spec. At minimum, provide a title and a small spec object.
